task_definition.title: Fix stale "interim: hand-stamp" note in skills/prd/references/decompose-mode.md Step 5.5
task_definition.description:
Step 5.5 of skills/prd/references/decompose-mode.md contains a self-contradiction: its own prose (lines 147-149) already states "`commit_planning` is also the mechanical Greek-label → real-task-id mapping point: for every task in the batch carrying `metadata.prd_path` + `metadata.prd_task_label`, it locates the YAML sidecar from Step 2.5, stamps the matching label's `task_id`, writes the file back, and copies that label's mechanical (`grep`/`script`) `delivered_check`s into the producer task's `metadata.delivered_checks`" — but the very next paragraph (lines 150-151), a blockquote headed "> **Interim reality.**", contradicts it: "Until sibling task γ lands, `commit_planning` does not yet perform this stamp. Hand-stamp `task_id` into the sidecar and commit it yourself, matching the committed exemplar's file header."

Stage 1 reconciliation (finding 8923f426-ef3c-485f-a342-c67c46515861, run c1021536-18a1-4158-858a-c8e161b7c65d) identified this as a recurring-rediscovery root cause: at least 6 independent Mem0 memories across 2026-07-15..07-18 each independently re-derived and re-wrote the same correction — that commit_planning auto-stamps the capability-manifest YAML sidecar (landed via task 2578, live since 2026-07-16) — because the doc itself was never fixed, so every /prd decompose session reads the stale "Interim reality" note and re-discovers the same fact fresh.

FIX: delete (or rewrite) the "> **Interim reality.**" blockquote at Step 5.5 (lines 150-151) so it no longer instructs hand-stamping. Replace with a short note that `commit_planning` auto-stamps the sidecar (task 2578, live since 2026-07-16), matching the description already given two paragraphs above it. Single coherent doc edit, no source changes.

User-observable signal: skills/prd/references/decompose-mode.md Step 5.5 no longer contains the "Interim reality: hand-stamp" instruction; a `git log` entry documents the fix.
